copied_files.note: shared with B3/B9; data pipeline functions + shared TCN building block

adaptation_notes: Only task/seed/output routing and cross-platform paths were changed vs. the original: (1) split_grouped_lifecycle(df) [hardcoded C1+C4->C6] generalized to split_by_conditions(df, train_conditions, test_condition) -- this generalization was already validated in the old project (final_statistical_evidence), not invented here; (2) FEATURE_FILE now resolves to this repo's data/PHM2010/features/run_level_features_all.csv; (3) RANDOM_SEED usage in feature selection/GMM is now an explicit preprocess_seed parameter (value unchanged, 42) instead of a mutable module global; (4) model construction (build_stage_model) factored out from the training loop (train_stage_model) to fit this repo's MethodAdapter.build_model()/train() hook split -- seed_everything() still runs immediately before model construction with nothing in between, so isolation is preserved exactly. No architecture, hyperparameter, or optimizer change. Verified 2026-08-30: CPU smoke test (prepare+build_model+predict on real D1 data, untrained weights) produces 304 test-window predictions with the expected schema.
